items.question: Which additional substances must be consecrated together for seven days in this preparation?
premises: The white substance is included in the preparation.
Both are to be treated equally for seven days.
items.inference: The white substance and girikarṇī are jointly consecrated in equal measure over seven days.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the substance designated as śvetā is not specified.
items.plain_english: The white substance and girikarṇī are to be treated together equally for seven days.
